name: Beat Sheet to Scene List
description: Declarative mapping from beats to scene goals, places, people, conflict, turn, and exit state. Not executed.

stages.title: Beat
stages.intent: Take one beat as input. This pack does not run a node graph.

stages.title: Scene Goal
stages.intent: What must be true by the end of the scene.

stages.title: Location
stages.intent: Where the camera can actually be.

stages.title: Characters
stages.intent: Who must be present for the beat to land.

stages.title: Conflict
stages.intent: The visible opposition inside the scene.

stages.title: Turn
stages.intent: The change that justifies cutting elsewhere.

stages.title: Exit State
stages.intent: Information, alliance, or geography after the cut.
